name: gltfjsx
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: CLI that turns a .glb/.gltf into a react-three-fiber JSX component
summary: Command-line tool that parses a glTF/GLB and emits a React Three Fiber component with each mesh, material and animation clip as addressable JSX, optionally TypeScript and with Draco/meshopt optimisation via gltf-transform. Run once at build time; output is source code. Distinguishing strength: scene graph becomes editable, typed JSX.
use_when: Over loading a raw GLB when you need to restyle or animate individual meshes in R3F
Generating typed R3F components for a model as a build step
Pruning and compressing a model while generating its component
avoid_when: Non-React Three.js: GLTFLoader directly, or three-js

assessment.rationale: Slow: last release Nov 2024 (about 23 months), no recent commits. Still the only CLI turning a .glb into typed react-three-fiber JSX; gltf-transform optimises but does not generate components. Recheck before relying on it.
